room.temp_range.help: This range applies only to this room. Empty fields inherit the corresponding space bounds; if the bounds are reversed, House Plan uses the smaller value as the lower bound and the larger value as the upper bound.
room.sizes_section.help: Name and metric sizes independently multiply their corresponding Space sizes.
room.group_basics.help: The area helps locate this room’s devices. Without an area, devices and data sources can still be assigned manually.
room.group_fill.help: This room’s fill overrides the space one; a custom colour is kept for this room only.
room.group_sources.help: Selected sources replace room averages. Temperature also sets the temperature fill. CO₂ requires carbon dioxide sensors in ppm.
room.group_sources.help.aria: Help: temperature, humidity and CO₂ sources
marker.hide_signal: Hide the Zigbee signal level on the plan
marker.hide_signal_help: Hides only this marker’s system LQI line. Your selected values and badges, tooltip and Zigbee routes remain available.
space.scale_changed: Changing the scale recalculates the dimensions of the whole space when you save. Points on the plan stay where they are.
space.plan.help: Choose how to create the plan: draw walls in the editor or use an existing image. Switching to drawing keeps the image.
space.source_draw_hint: Outline rooms in the plan editor.
space.source_file_hint: Add an image to draw over.
space.plan_kept: Your uploaded image is kept. Switch back to use it again.
space.fill_lqi_hint: Uses average room LQI: low at 40 or below, high at 180 or above. Colors and opacity follow the general palette.
space.fill_light_hint: Uses separate colors for any light on, all lights off, and no light sources. Colors and opacity follow the general palette.
space.error_title: Enter a name for the space.
space.error_plan: Add a floor-plan image or switch to drawing by hand.
space.error_scale: Enter a scale within the allowed range.
space.error_temp_range: The maximum must be higher than the minimum.
space.error_north: Enter a whole number between 0° and 359°.
space.delete_devices_body: Its devices will be deleted too: {n}.
gs.show_room_tooltip_hint: Hover a room on the plan to see its summary.
gs.radar_show_live_hint: Hides or shows all live radar targets. This does not start or stop observation recording.
gs.volumetric_view_hint: Renders walls, doors, windows and device markers with depth. Decor and the flat plan stay unchanged.
gs.moon: Moon over the plan at dusk and night
gs.moon_hint: Shown behind the plan with any background, from 3° above the horizon, except around new moon; computed from the home coordinates in Home Assistant.
gs.moon_status_shown: Now: shown ({alt}° above the horizon, {pct}% lit).
gs.moon_status_no_home: Now: not shown (the home location is not set in Home Assistant).
gs.moon_status_day_sun: Now: not shown (the sun is {sun}° above the horizon; the moon shows once it is below 6°).
gs.moon_status_day_clock: Now: not shown (daytime by the clock, 08:00–18:00: Home Assistant has no sun.sun data).
gs.moon_status_low: Now: not shown (the moon is at {alt}°; it shows from 3° above the horizon).
gs.moon_status_new: Now: not shown (new moon, {pct}% lit; it shows from 3%).
gs.error_glow_radius: Enter a radius greater than zero.
gs.error_north: Enter a whole number between 0° and 359°.
room.sizes_hint: Room sizes multiply the space defaults: name {name}%, readings {metrics}%. The preview is a sample for sizing.
room.error_temp_range: Enter numbers for the comfort bounds.
room.error_name: Enter a name or choose an area.
marker.binding.help: Choose a Home Assistant device to show its state and control it from the plan. A virtual device is a marker without a Home Assistant connection.
marker.binding.help.aria: Help: binding to a Home Assistant device
marker.room_hint_auto: Placed by the device’s Home Assistant area.
marker.room_hint_override: Overrides the placement by device area.
marker.icon.help: Empty means automatic: the icon comes from the icon rules for this device. Pick one to override, or pin the automatic choice.
marker.display.help: How the marker face reacts to state and activity. The value modes replace the icon with a Home Assistant value.
marker.size.help: Scales and rotates only this marker on the plan. The tap area grows with the icon.
marker.error_binding: Choose a device or entity to bind.
marker.error_virtual_name: Enter a name for the virtual device.
marker.error_value_badge_source: Choose a value source for the badge.
gs.optimize_no_changes: There are no automatic changes to apply.
gs.optimize_unverified: Old position records that could not be matched to objects: {n}. They were left unchanged.
gs.optimize_unverified_safe: These records refer to deleted spaces. Unused positions can be cleaned up separately; unchecked or used records are kept unchanged.
gs.optimize_unverified_legacy: Old per-area lamp groups (before v1.5.0): {n}{names}. The current version does not use them.
gs.optimize_unverified_unknown: Could not determine what these records belong to: {n}.
gs.optimize_unverified_unchecked: Not checked because Home Assistant data is incomplete: {n}.
gs.optimize_registry_limited: Home Assistant data is incomplete, so the check is incomplete.
gs.optimize_registry_still_limited: The data is still unavailable. A full check needs administrator access to the Home Assistant registries.
gs.radar_show_live: Show live presence on the plan
gs.title: General settings
gs.optimize_write_required: Optimize and Undo require Houseplan write permission. These actions are unavailable in kiosk mode.
gs.optimize_preview_changed: The plan or check data changed. The report was refreshed; review it and select cleanup again.
gs.optimize_invalid_eligible: Old positions safe to clean up: {n}.
gs.optimize_invalid_hint: This button only previews removal. Records change after Apply changes; Optimize Undo can restore them.
gs.optimize_invalid_none_safe: No records can safely be removed right now.
gs.optimize_invalid_selected: Only unused records will be removed in full: {n}.
gs.optimize_invalid_registry_unavailable: Not enough Home Assistant data to confirm removal: {n}.
gs.optimize_invalid_unsupported_model: Created by a newer model version: {n}.
gs.optimize_invalid_done: Unused records removed: {n}. Report refreshed. Optimize Undo is available.
gs.optimize_visible_positions: Positions in existing spaces: {n} of {total} shifted.
gs.optimize_missing_space_positions: Archived positions in deleted spaces: {n} of {total} shifted. These are not visible plan objects.
gs.optimize_vacuum_action: Vacuum “{name}”: check segment links in Device editor → vacuum → Maps. This report does not remove them or change calibration.
gs.north_description: North helps position rays from windows correctly.
gs.sun_rays_override: Enabled. A space can override this.
gs.daynight_rules: Day starts at 6° above the horizon; night starts at 6° below it. Between them, twilight is dawn while the Sun rises and dusk while it sets.
gs.converter_description: If you have a Sweet Home 3D (.sh3d) or Easy Floorplan (YAML / JSON) plan, convert it to House Plan:
gs.converter_result: The result is JSON, which you can upload with Import.
gs.space_overrides: Spaces with their own values: {names}. Changing the global setting will not affect them.
gs.sun_rays_override_off: Disabled. A space can override this.
gs.glow_radius_hint: For devices without their own glow radius
gs.north_angle_hint: 0° points up the plan, 90° to the right. Angles run clockwise.
gs.default_light_help: Light colour and intensity for devices without their own glow colour.
gs.daynight_source: The background around the plan follows the Sun in Home Assistant. The plan keeps its own colours.
gs.daynight_clock: If Sun data is unavailable, device time is used: dawn 05:00–08:00, day 08:00–18:00, dusk 18:00–21:00, night 21:00–05:00.
gs.fill_palette_help: Used by rooms with the corresponding fill mode. Choose the mode in space or room settings.
gs.battery_help: The default device mode. A space can override it, and a device can hide its own battery indicator.
gs.signal_help: System LQI numbers beside devices. Does not hide Zigbee fills, room metrics, a selected LQI badge or Zigbee links.
gs.wall_help: The body of thick walls, separate from room fills and space boundary or name colours.
gs.global_value_caption: Global value for the whole installation
space.metrics_source_hint: A reading appears when a data source is available.
space.borders_openings_hint: Turn off if boundaries and openings are already drawn in the plan image.
space.borders_openings: Show room boundaries (including doors and windows)
space.image.help: Choose a plan image in SVG, PNG, JPG or WebP. Rooms and devices remain editable.
space.decor.help: Show the decorative layer on this plan. Its objects remain in the background editor when hidden.
space.border_color.help: Colour and opacity of room boundaries and names in this space.
space.fill_color.help: The custom room fill for this space. A room can choose its own fill.
space.comfort.help: The lower and upper comfort limits used by the temperature fill.
space.name_size.help: Base size of room names in this space. A room can apply its own name scale.
space.metrics_size.help: Base size of room metrics in this space, independent of room names.
space.metric_temp.help: Show the current room temperature from its configured source.
space.metric_hum.help: Show the current room humidity from its configured source.
space.metric_co2.help: Show the room CO₂ level in ppm.
space.metric_lqi.help: Show the average Zigbee signal for devices in the room.
space.metric_light.help: Show how many room light sources are on.
space.names.help: Show room names and selected metrics. Hiding them keeps their settings and positions.
room.title: {name} · room settings
marker.value_source_instead: Value source instead of the icon
marker.sources_explanation: The value replacing the icon and the badge are independent. Choose each source separately; the preview shows the result.
marker.link_hint: You can add a link to the manufacturer’s website or this device’s page.
marker.legacy_radar_hint: This device has previously saved radar settings. They continue to work and can be edited or removed.
marker.binding_search_hint: Search by device name. To select an individual entity, enable “Show entities”.
marker.hide_battery.help: Hides the battery level for this device. Space and other device settings stay unchanged.
marker.binding_search_hint.aria: Help: choose a Home Assistant device
marker.room.help: Choose a room for this device on the plan. Linked devices may keep automatic placement by their Home Assistant area.
